records.literal_gloss: For the director, with stringed instruments, on the sheminith. A psalm of David.

en.L: For the director: with stringed instruments, on the sheminith. A psalm of David.
en.B: For the music director. With stringed instruments, on the sheminith. A psalm of David.
en.R: For the leader of the music. To be played on stringed instruments, set to "the eighth". A song of David.

fr.L: Au chef de chœur : avec instruments à cordes, sur la sheminith. Un psaume de David.
fr.B: Au chef de chœur. Avec instruments à cordes, sur la sheminith. Un psaume de David.
fr.R: Pour le chef des musiciens. À jouer sur des instruments à cordes, sur « la huitième ». Un chant de David.

sw.L: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya: kwa ala za nyuzi, kwa sheminithi. Zaburi ya Daudi.
sw.B: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Kwa ala za nyuzi, kwa sheminithi. Zaburi ya Daudi.
sw.R: Kwa kiongozi wa waimbaji. Ipigwe kwa ala za nyuzi, kwa mtindo wa "ya nane". Wimbo wa Daudi.

es.L: Al director del coro: con instrumentos de cuerda, sobre la seminit. Salmo de David.
es.B: Al director del coro. Con instrumentos de cuerda, sobre la seminit. Salmo de David.
es.R: Para el director de la música. Para tocarse con instrumentos de cuerda, en «la octava». Canto de David.

vi.L: Cho người chỉ huy [ban nhạc]: với đàn dây, theo [điệu] Sê-mi-nít. [Một] thi thiên của Đa-vít.
vi.B: Cho nhạc trưởng. Với đàn dây, theo điệu Sê-mi-nít. Thi thiên của Đa-vít.
vi.R: Cho người hướng dẫn ban nhạc. Để chơi bằng đàn dây, theo "cung thứ tám". Bài ca của Đa-vít.

ko.L: 지휘자를 위하여. 현악기에 맞추어, 스미닛에 따라. 다윗의 시.
ko.B: 음악 지휘자를 위하여. 현악기에 맞추어, 스미닛에 따라. 다윗의 시.
ko.R: 찬양 인도자를 위해 다윗이 지은 노래. 현악기로 "여덟째"에 맞추어 연주한다.

pt.L: Para o regente: com instrumentos de cordas, sobre a seminite. Salmo de Davi.
pt.B: Para o mestre de música. Com instrumentos de cordas, sobre a seminite. Salmo de Davi.
pt.R: Para quem dirige a música. Para ser tocado com instrumentos de cordas, no tom chamado "a oitava". Canção de Davi.

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: As in Psalm 3, the title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the director: the one who leads the music
decisions.reason: As in 4:1, probably the leader of the temple music.

decisions.choice: the sheminith: "the eighth", a musical direction
decisions.reason: The word (sheminit) means "the eighth". 1 Chronicles 15:21 uses the same phrase of Levites playing lyres. It may name an instrument, a pitch or a tune; its sense is no longer known, so Literal and Balanced keep the word.

decisions.choice: set to "the eighth"; song
decisions.reason: Readable translates the word and, as in 3:1, says what a psalm is.

decisions.choice: "la sheminith" kept as a name (Literal, Balanced); "« la huitième »" at Readable
decisions.reason: The word means "the eighth" and is a musical direction whose sense is lost (m3). French follows the English level by level: the name where it keeps the name, the plain meaning of the word where it translates.

decisions.choice: "sheminithi" kept as a name (L, B); "kwa mtindo wa \"ya nane\"" (in the style of "the eighth") at Readable
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word means "the eighth", but what it directed in the music is no longer known (m3). Literal and Balanced keep it as a name, as the English does; Readable translates the word and says it is a way of playing, without guessing which.

decisions.choice: la seminit (L, B); «la octava» (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sheminith means "the eighth", but what it meant for the music (a tuning, an eight-stringed instrument, a lower octave) is no longer known. Literal and Balanced keep the word, Readable gives its plain meaning, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Sê-mi-nít" kept as a name (L, B); "cung thứ tám" (R)
decisions.reason: The word means "the eighth", but no one knows what in the music it named (see the meaning decision). Literal and Balanced keep it as a name, as the English does; Readable gives the plain meaning of the word in quotation marks, without claiming to know more. "quãng tám" (octave) would claim more than is known.

decisions.choice: "스미닛" kept as a name (L, B); "여덟째" (the eighth) at Readable
decisions.reason: The Hebrew means "the eighth" but its musical sense is lost (meaning decision m3). Korean keeps the word as a name at Literal and Balanced, as the English keeps "sheminith", and translates it at Readable as the English does, without guessing more.

decisions.choice: a seminite (L, B); no tom chamado "a oitava" (R)
decisions.reason: As 1 Chronicles 15:21 has the same term in Portuguese: Literal and Balanced keep the word, written "seminite", and Readable translates it, as the English does (m3).

records.literal_gloss: YHWH, do not in your anger rebuke me, and do not in your wrath discipline me.

en.L: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, do not in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} anger rebuke me, and do not in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} wrath discipline me.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, when {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} correct me, do not do it in anger; when {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} discipline me, do not do it in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} fury.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, do not be angry when {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} correct me. Do not punish me in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} fury.

fr.L: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ne me reprends pas dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère, et ne me corrige pas dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fureur.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me reprends, que ce ne soit pas avec colère ; quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me corriges, que ce ne soit pas dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fureur.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ne sois pas en colère quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me corriges. Ne me punis pas dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fureur.

sw.L: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} usinikaripie, wala katika ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} usinirudi.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unaponikosoa, usifanye hivyo kwa hasira; unaponirudi, usifanye hivyo kwa ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

es.L: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, no en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ira me reprendas, y no en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} furor me disciplines.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, cuando me corrijas, no lo hagas con enojo; cuando me disciplines, no lo hagas con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} furia.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} enojes cuando me corrijas. No me castigues con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} furia.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin đừng trách phạt tôi trong cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và đừng sửa phạt tôi trong cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} quở trách tôi, xin đừng làm trong cơn giận; khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sửa phạt tôi, xin đừng làm trong cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sửa dạy tôi, xin đừng nổi giận. Xin đừng trừng phạt tôi trong cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 진노로 저를 꾸짖지 마시고, 주님의 분노로 저를 징계하지 마십시오.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저를 바로잡으실 때 노하여 하지 마시고, 저를 징계하실 때 진노하여 하지 마십시오.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저를 바로잡으실 때 화내지 말아 주십시오. 분노하셔서 저를 벌하지 말아 주십시오.

pt.L: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, não na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} ira me repreendas, e não no {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} furor me disciplines.
pt.B: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, quando {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me corrigires, não o faças com ira; quando me disciplinares, não o faças com a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} fúria.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, não fiques irado quando me corrigires. Não me castigues com a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} fúria.

decisions.choice: not in your anger: correction without anger
decisions.reason: The psalmist does not ask to escape correction, only that it not come in anger, as Jeremiah prays: "correct me, LORD, but with justice, not in your anger" (Jeremiah 10:24). Psalm 38:2 opens with the same words.

decisions.choice: rebuke, discipline: correction, as a father corrects
decisions.reason: To rebuke (yakach) is to set right, and to discipline (yasar) is to train by correction, as a father does a son (Proverbs 3:11-12).

decisions.choice: wrath: burning anger
decisions.reason: The word (chemah) is heat, the burning of anger.

decisions.choice: when you correct me, do not do it in anger
alternatives: do not rebuke me in your anger
decisions.reason: Balanced puts the correction first to make plain that the prayer is about the anger, not the correction (m1).

source.text: חָנֵּ֥נִי יְהוָה֮ כִּ֤י אֻמְלַ֫ל אָ֥נִי רְפָאֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֖י נִבְהֲל֣וּ עֲצָמָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Be gracious to me, YHWH, for frail [am] I; heal me, YHWH, for terrified are my bones.

en.L: Be gracious to me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, for withering [am] I; heal me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, for my bones are terrified.
en.B: Show me grace, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, for I am wasting away; heal me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, for my very bones are shaking.
en.R: Be kind to me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, because I am weak and fading. Heal me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, because my whole body is shaking.

fr.L: Fais-moi grâce, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car je dépéris ; guéris-moi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car mes os sont épouvantés.
fr.B: Fais-moi grâce, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car je m’épuise ; guéris-moi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car jusqu’à mes os tremblent.
fr.R: Sois bon pour moi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, parce que je suis faible et que mes forces s’en vont. Guéris-moi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, parce que tout mon corps tremble.

sw.L: Unifanyie neema, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana ninanyauka mimi; uniponye, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana mifupa yangu imetetemeka kwa hofu.
sw.B: Unihurumie, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana ninadhoofika; uniponye, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana hata mifupa yangu inatetemeka.
sw.R: Unionee huruma, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu nimedhoofika na ninafifia. Uniponye, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu mwili wangu wote unatetemeka.

es.L: Ten piedad de mí, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque desfallecido [estoy] yo; sáname, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque mis huesos están aterrados.
es.B: Muéstrame {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} gracia, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque me estoy consumiendo; sáname, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque hasta mis huesos tiemblan.
es.R: Sé bondadoso conmigo, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque estoy débil y sin fuerzas. Sáname, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque todo mi cuerpo tiembla.

vi.L: Xin thương xót tôi, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì tôi [đang] héo hon; xin chữa lành tôi, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì xương cốt tôi kinh hãi.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin ban ơn cho tôi, vì tôi đang mòn mỏi; lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin chữa lành tôi, vì đến xương cốt tôi cũng run rẩy.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin tỏ lòng tốt với tôi, vì tôi yếu đuối và kiệt sức. Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin chữa lành tôi, vì cả thân thể tôi đang run rẩy.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제게 은혜를 베풀어 주십시오. 제가 시들어 가기 때문입니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저를 고쳐 주십시오. 제 뼈가 떨리기 때문입니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 은혜를 베풀어 주십시오. 제가 쇠약해져 갑니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저를 고쳐 주십시오. 제 뼈마디까지 떨립니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저를 불쌍히 여겨 주십시오. 저는 힘이 없고 시들어 갑니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저를 고쳐 주십시오. 온몸이 떨립니다.

pt.L: Sê gracioso comigo, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, porque murchando [estou] eu; cura-me, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, porque os meus ossos estão apavorados.
pt.B: Mostra-me a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} graça, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, porque estou definhando; cura-me, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, porque até os meus ossos tremem.
pt.R: Sê bondoso comigo, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, porque estou fraco e sem forças. Cura-me, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, porque o meu corpo inteiro está tremendo.

decisions.choice: withering: weak and fading
decisions.reason: The word ('umlal) is used of plants and fields that wither (Joel 1:10, 12; Isaiah 24:7). The psalmist's strength is drying up.

decisions.choice: terrified: shaken, in dismay
decisions.reason: The verb (bahal) means to be shaken with terror. It comes three times: his bones (here), his soul (verse 4), and at the end his enemies (verse 11), who are shaken as he was.

decisions.choice: my bones: my whole body, my inmost self
decisions.reason: The bones stand for the whole person, body and strength (Psalm 22:15; 32:3). The psalm sounds like serious illness as well as danger from enemies (verse 8).

decisions.choice: my whole body
decisions.reason: Readable says what "my bones" means here (m3).

source.text: וְ֭נַפְשִׁי נִבְהֲלָ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וְאַתָּ֥ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה עַד־מָתָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And my soul is terrified exceedingly; and you, YHWH, until when?

en.L: And my soul is terrified exceedingly; and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, until when?
en.B: My soul is shaken to its depths. But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, how long?
en.R: I am so afraid. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, how long will it be before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} help me?

fr.L: Et mon âme est épouvantée à l’extrême ; et {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, jusqu’à quand ?
fr.B: Je suis bouleversé jusqu’au fond de moi. Mais {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, jusqu’à quand ?
fr.R: J’ai tellement peur ! {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, combien de temps faudra-t-il encore avant que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} viennes m’aider ?

sw.L: Na nafsi yangu imetetemeka kwa hofu mno; {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hata lini?
sw.B: Nafsi yangu imetikiswa hadi ndani kabisa. Lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hata lini?
sw.R: Ninaogopa sana. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, itachukua muda gani hadi unisaidie?

es.L: Y mi alma está aterrada en gran manera; y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¿hasta cuándo?
es.B: Mi alma está estremecida hasta lo más hondo. Pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¿hasta cuándo?
es.R: Tengo mucho miedo. {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¿cuánto tiempo pasará antes de que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me ayudes?

vi.L: Và linh hồn tôi kinh hãi vô cùng; còn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, cho đến bao giờ?
vi.B: Linh hồn tôi bị chấn động tận đáy sâu. Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, cho đến bao giờ?
vi.R: Tôi sợ hãi vô cùng. Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, còn bao lâu nữa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mới giúp tôi?

ko.L: 그리고 제 영혼이 몹시 떨립니다. 그러나 주님은, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 언제까지입니까?
ko.B: 제 영혼이 속속들이 떨립니다. 그런데 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 언제까지입니까?
ko.R: 저는 너무나 두렵습니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 언제쯤 저를 도와주시겠습니까?

pt.L: E a minha alma está apavorada em extremo; e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, até quando?
pt.B: A minha alma está abalada até o fundo. Mas {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, até quando?
pt.R: Eu estou com muito medo. {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, quanto tempo vai demorar até que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me ajudes?

decisions.choice: and you, LORD, how long?: a sentence broken off
decisions.reason: The question breaks off: how long will you stay away, how long will this go on? Psalm 13:2-3 asks "how long" four times.

decisions.choice: my soul: my whole self
decisions.reason: The soul (nefesh) is the whole living person; the terror has reached his very life.

decisions.choice: you: the word as read, not as written
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text writes the word "you" in a form that is usually feminine, and its notes say to read the usual masculine form. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: how long will it be before you help me?
decisions.reason: Readable finishes the question the psalmist leaves open (m1).

decisions.choice: "linh hồn tôi" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The terms note keeps "linh hồn" for nefesh at Literal; Balanced keeps it here too because the whole self, body and soul, is shaken (see the meaning decision), and Readable says simply "tôi".

source.text: שׁוּבָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה חַלְּצָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י ה֝וֹשִׁיעֵ֗נִי לְמַ֣עַן חַסְדֶּֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Turn, YHWH, rescue my soul; save me for the sake of your loyal love.

en.L: Return, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, rescue my soul; save me for the sake of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love.
en.B: Turn back to me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, and set my life free; save me because {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} love is loyal.
en.R: Come back, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, and rescue me! Save me, because {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} love for me is faithful.

fr.L: Reviens, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, délivre mon âme ; sauve-moi à cause de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal.
fr.B: Reviens vers moi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et libère ma vie ; sauve-moi, car {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour est fidèle.
fr.R: Reviens, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et délivre-moi ! Sauve-moi, parce que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour pour moi est fidèle.

sw.L: Rudi, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, uiokoe nafsi yangu; uniokoe kwa ajili ya upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma.
sw.B: Unirudie, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, uyaweke huru maisha yangu; uniokoe kwa sababu upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} haukomi.
sw.R: Rudi, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unisaidie! Uniokoe, kwa sababu upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kwangu haukomi.

es.L: Vuelve, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, rescata mi alma; sálvame por causa de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor leal.
es.B: Vuélvete a mí, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y libra mi vida; sálvame, porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor es fiel.
es.R: Regresa, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¡y rescátame! Sálvame, porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor por mí es fiel.

vi.L: Xin trở lại, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin giải cứu linh hồn tôi; xin cứu tôi vì cớ tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin quay lại với tôi và giải thoát mạng sống tôi; xin cứu tôi vì tình yêu thương của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là thành tín.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin hãy trở lại và giải cứu tôi! Xin cứu tôi, vì tình thương {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dành cho tôi không hề thay đổi.

ko.L: 돌아오십시오, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제 영혼을 건져 주십시오. 주님의 한결같은 사랑 때문에 저를 구원해 주십시오.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제게로 돌아오셔서 제 목숨을 건져 주십시오. 주님의 사랑은 한결같으시니 저를 구원해 주십시오.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 돌아오셔서 저를 구해 주십시오! 저를 향한 주님의 사랑은 변함없으시니 저를 구원해 주십시오.

pt.L: Volta, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, livra a minha alma; salva-me por causa do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor leal.
pt.B: Volta-te para mim, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, e liberta a minha vida; salva-me, porque o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor é leal.
pt.R: Volta, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, e me livra! Salva-me, porque o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor por mim é fiel.

decisions.choice: turn: come back to me
decisions.reason: The verb (shuv) means to turn or return. God seems to have turned away; the psalmist asks him to come back. The same verb returns in verse 11, when the enemies "turn back".

decisions.choice: rescue my soul: pull my life out of danger
decisions.reason: The verb (chalats) means to draw out or set free; the soul (nefesh) here is his life, which is at risk (verse 6).

decisions.choice: loyal love: God's faithful love
decisions.reason: As in 5:8, chesed is love that keeps faith. The psalmist appeals to it, not to any claim of his own.

decisions.choice: loyal love (L); love is loyal (B)
decisions.reason: As in 5:8; Readable says "faithful".

source.text: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ין בַּמָּ֣וֶת זִכְרֶ֑ךָ בִּ֝שְׁא֗וֹל מִ֣י יֽוֹדֶה־לָּֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: For there is not in death remembrance of you; in Sheol who will give thanks to you?

en.L: For in death there is no remembrance of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; in Sheol who will give thanks to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}?
en.B: For in death no one calls {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} to mind. Who gives {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} thanks down in Sheol?
en.R: Dead people cannot remember {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. No one in the place of the dead can thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: Car dans la mort il n’y a pas de souvenir de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ; dans le Shéol, qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendra grâce ?
fr.B: Car dans la mort, personne ne se souvient de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. Là-bas, au séjour des morts, qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rend grâce ?
fr.R: Les morts ne peuvent pas se souvenir de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. Au séjour des morts, personne ne peut {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} remercier.

sw.L: Kwa maana katika mauti hakuna kukukumbuka; katika Kuzimu ni nani atakayekushukuru?
sw.B: Kwa maana katika kifo hakuna anayekukumbuka. Ni nani anayekushukuru huko chini Kuzimu?
sw.R: Watu waliokufa hawawezi kukukumbuka. Hakuna mtu aliye Kuzimu anayeweza kukushukuru.

es.L: Porque en la muerte no hay memoria de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; en el Seol, ¿quién {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dará gracias?
es.B: Porque en la muerte nadie se acuerda de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. ¿Quién {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} da gracias allá abajo, en el lugar de los muertos?
es.R: Los muertos no pueden acordarse de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Nadie en el lugar de los muertos puede darte gracias.

vi.L: Vì trong sự chết không có sự nhớ đến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; nơi Âm Phủ ai sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?
vi.B: Vì trong cõi chết chẳng ai nhớ đến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Dưới Âm Phủ, ai cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?
vi.R: Người chết không thể nhớ đến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Không ai ở nơi của người chết có thể cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 참으로 죽음 속에서는 주님을 기억함이 없으니, 스올에서 누가 주님께 감사하겠습니까?
ko.B: 죽으면 아무도 주님을 기억하지 못합니다. 스올에서 누가 주님께 감사를 드리겠습니까?
ko.R: 죽은 사람은 주님을 기억할 수 없습니다. 죽은 사람들이 있는 곳에서는 아무도 주님께 감사할 수 없습니다.

pt.L: Porque na morte não há lembrança de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; no Sheol quem {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dará graças?
pt.B: Pois na morte ninguém se lembra de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Quem {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dá graças lá no mundo dos mortos?
pt.R: Os mortos não conseguem se lembrar de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Ninguém no mundo dos mortos pode {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} agradecer.

decisions.choice: Sheol: the place of the dead
decisions.reason: Sheol is the place of the dead, pictured below the earth, where all go down at death (Genesis 37:35). It is not a place of punishment in particular.

decisions.choice: no remembrance, no thanks: a reason for God to save
decisions.reason: To remember God (zeker) here is to call on him and speak of him in praise. If the psalmist dies, God loses a voice that thanks him (Psalm 30:10; Isaiah 38:18). The psalm is not teaching what happens after death; it pleads for life now. Later Scripture speaks more fully of hope beyond death (Isaiah 26:19; Daniel 12:2).

decisions.choice: the place of the dead
decisions.reason: Readable says what Sheol is (m1); Literal and Balanced keep the name.

decisions.choice: Sheol: "le Shéol" (Literal), "le séjour des morts" (Balanced, Readable), for the whole book
decisions.reason: Sheol is the place of the dead (m1), not hell. Literal keeps the name; the other levels say what it is.

decisions.choice: "Kuzimu" for Sheol at every level, through the Psalms
decisions.reason: "Kuzimu" is the Swahili word for the world of the dead below, so it says what Sheol is (m1) at every level and needs no explanation at Readable, where the English says "the place of the dead". "Kaburi" would name one tomb only.

decisions.choice: el Seol (L); el lugar de los muertos (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew Sheol is the place of the dead. Literal keeps the name "el Seol"; Balanced and Readable say what it is, "el lugar de los muertos". "El infierno" would bring in the later idea of punishment.

decisions.choice: "Âm Phủ" (L, B); "nơi của người chết" (R), as Psalm 139:8
decisions.reason: The place of the dead is named as in the published Psalm 139:8, through the book: "Âm Phủ" is the word Bible readers know, and Readable says what it is, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "스올" (L, B); "죽은 사람들이 있는 곳" (R)
decisions.reason: As the terms note and the published Psalm 139:8: the place of the dead (meaning decision m1). "음부" is an older church word few readers know, "무덤" is one grave, and "지옥" says a place of punishment. This holds for Sheol through Psalms 6-25.

decisions.choice: o Sheol (L); o mundo dos mortos (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as the Old Testament terms set it: Literal keeps the name; Balanced and Readable say what Sheol is, the place of the dead (m1), where the English Balanced keeps "Sheol". "Inferno" would suggest a place of punishment, which Sheol is not, and "sepultura" is one grave.

source.text: יָגַ֤עְתִּי׀בְּֽאַנְחָתִ֗י אַשְׂחֶ֣ה בְכָל־לַ֭יְלָה מִטָּתִ֑י בְּ֝דִמְעָתִ֗י עַרְשִׂ֥י אַמְסֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: I am weary with my groaning; I make swim every night my bed; with my tears my couch I melt.

en.L: I am weary with my groaning; every night I make my bed swim; with my tears I melt my couch.
en.B: I am exhausted from groaning. Night after night my bed swims with my tears, and my couch dissolves in them.
en.R: I am tired out from groaning. Every night I cry so much that my bed is soaked with my tears.

fr.L: Je suis épuisé par mon gémissement ; chaque nuit je fais nager mon lit ; de mes larmes je fais fondre ma couche.
fr.B: Je suis à bout de forces à force de gémir. Nuit après nuit mon lit nage dans mes larmes, et ma couche s’y dissout.
fr.R: Je suis fatigué de gémir. Chaque nuit, je pleure tellement que mon lit est trempé de larmes.

sw.L: Nimechoka kwa kuugua kwangu; kila usiku ninakiogelesha kitanda changu; kwa machozi yangu ninayayeyusha malazi yangu.
sw.B: Nimechoka kabisa kwa kuugua. Usiku baada ya usiku kitanda changu kinaogelea katika machozi yangu, na malazi yangu yanayeyuka ndani yake.
sw.R: Nimechoka sana kwa kuugua. Kila usiku ninalia sana hata kitanda changu kinaloa kwa machozi yangu.

es.L: Estoy cansado de mi gemir; cada noche hago nadar mi cama; con mis lágrimas derrito mi lecho.
es.B: Estoy agotado de tanto gemir. Noche tras noche mi cama nada en mis lágrimas, y mi lecho se deshace en ellas.
es.R: Estoy rendido de tanto gemir. Cada noche lloro tanto que mi cama queda empapada de lágrimas.

vi.L: Tôi mệt mỏi vì than thở; mỗi đêm tôi làm giường tôi bơi; bằng nước mắt tôi làm tan chảy chỗ nằm của tôi.
vi.B: Tôi kiệt sức vì rên siết. Đêm này qua đêm khác giường tôi ngập trong nước mắt, và chỗ nằm của tôi rã ra vì chúng.
vi.R: Tôi mệt lả vì than khóc. Đêm nào tôi cũng khóc nhiều đến nỗi giường tôi ướt đẫm nước mắt.

ko.L: 제가 탄식으로 지쳤습니다. 밤마다 제 침상을 떠다니게 하고, 제 눈물로 제 잠자리를 녹입니다.
ko.B: 저는 신음하다 지쳤습니다. 밤마다 제 침대는 눈물에 떠다니고, 제 잠자리는 눈물에 녹아내립니다.
ko.R: 저는 신음하다 지쳐 버렸습니다. 밤마다 너무 울어서 제 침대가 눈물에 흠뻑 젖습니다.

pt.L: Estou cansado do meu gemido; toda noite faço nadar a minha cama; com as minhas lágrimas derreto o meu leito.
pt.B: Estou esgotado de tanto gemer. Noite após noite a minha cama nada nas minhas lágrimas, e o meu leito se desfaz nelas.
pt.R: Estou exausto de tanto gemer. Toda noite eu choro tanto que a minha cama fica encharcada de lágrimas.

decisions.choice: I make my bed swim, I melt my couch: weeping without end
decisions.reason: The pictures are deliberate overstatement: so many tears that the bed swims and the couch melts. Night, when others sleep (3:6; 4:9), is when his grief is worst.

decisions.choice: groaning: sighing in pain
decisions.reason: The word ('anachah) is a groan or sigh of distress.

decisions.choice: I cry so much that my bed is soaked
alternatives: I make my bed swim; I melt my couch
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what the pictures mean (m1).

records.literal_gloss: Wasted from grief is my eye; it has grown old because of all my foes.

en.L: My eye has wasted away from grief; it has grown old because of all my foes.
en.B: Grief has dimmed my eyes; they have aged because of all who oppose me.
en.R: I have cried so much that I can hardly see. My eyes are worn out because of all my enemies.

fr.L: Mon œil est consumé de chagrin ; il a vieilli à cause de tous mes adversaires.
fr.B: Le chagrin a obscurci mes yeux ; ils ont vieilli à cause de tous ceux qui s’opposent à moi.
fr.R: J’ai tant pleuré que j’y vois à peine. Mes yeux sont usés à cause de tous mes ennemis.

sw.L: Jicho langu limedhoofika kwa huzuni; limezeeka kwa sababu ya watesi wangu wote.
sw.B: Huzuni imeyafifiza macho yangu; yamezeeka kwa sababu ya wote wanaonipinga.
sw.R: Nimelia sana hata siwezi kuona vizuri. Macho yangu yamechoka kwa sababu ya adui zangu wote.

es.L: Mi ojo se ha consumido de pesar; ha envejecido a causa de todos mis adversarios.
es.B: La tristeza ha nublado mis ojos; han envejecido por culpa de todos los que se me oponen.
es.R: He llorado tanto que casi no puedo ver. Mis ojos están gastados por culpa de todos mis enemigos.

vi.L: Mắt tôi đã hao mòn vì sầu khổ; nó đã già đi vì mọi kẻ thù của tôi.
vi.B: Nỗi sầu khổ làm mắt tôi mờ đi; mắt tôi đã già đi vì mọi kẻ chống đối tôi.
vi.R: Tôi khóc nhiều đến nỗi gần như không còn thấy rõ. Mắt tôi mỏi mòn vì mọi kẻ thù của tôi.

ko.L: 제 눈이 슬픔으로 쇠하였고, 제 모든 대적 때문에 늙었습니다.
ko.B: 슬픔으로 제 눈이 흐려졌고, 저를 대적하는 모든 자 때문에 눈이 늙어 버렸습니다.
ko.R: 너무 울어서 앞이 잘 보이지 않습니다. 제 원수들 때문에 제 눈이 지쳐 버렸습니다.

pt.L: O meu olho se gastou de desgosto; tornou-se velho por causa de todos os meus inimigos.
pt.B: O desgosto escureceu os meus olhos; eles envelheceram por causa de todos os que se opõem a mim.
pt.R: Eu chorei tanto que mal consigo enxergar. Os meus olhos estão cansados por causa de todos os meus inimigos.

decisions.choice: my eye has wasted away: my strength is failing
decisions.reason: Bright eyes are a sign of strength and life (1 Samuel 14:27); dim eyes, of grief and weakness. Psalm 31:10 uses the same words: "my eye wastes away from grief" (also Job 17:7).

decisions.choice: grief: sorrow mixed with vexation
decisions.reason: The word (ka'as) is grief that has anger or provocation in it, here caused by his enemies.

decisions.choice: I have cried so much that I can hardly see
alternatives: my eye has wasted away from grief
decisions.reason: Readable says how grief has worn out his eyes, linking this verse to the tears of verse 7.

source.text: ס֣וּרוּ מִ֭מֶּנִּי כָּל־פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן כִּֽי־שָׁמַ֥ע יְ֝הוָ֗ה ק֣וֹל בִּכְיִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Turn away from me, all doers of iniquity, for YHWH has heard the sound of my weeping.

en.L: Depart from me, all workers of iniquity, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has heard the sound of my weeping.
en.B: Get away from me, all who practice evil, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has heard me weeping.
en.R: Go away, all you who do evil! {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has heard me crying.

fr.L: Éloignez-vous de moi, vous tous qui pratiquez l’iniquité, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a entendu le son de mes pleurs.
fr.B: Allez-vous-en loin de moi, vous tous qui faites le mal, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a entendu pleurer.
fr.R: Partez, vous tous qui faites le mal ! {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a entendu pleurer.

sw.L: Tokeni mbele yangu, enyi nyote mfanyao uovu, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesikia sauti ya kulia kwangu.
sw.B: Nendeni mbali nami, ninyi nyote mnaotenda maovu, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amenisikia nikilia.
sw.R: Ondokeni, ninyi nyote mnaotenda maovu! {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amenisikia nikilia.

es.L: {{plural_you:Apártense|Apartaos}} de mí, todos los que hacen iniquidad, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha oído la voz de mi llanto.
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Aléjense|Alejaos}} de mí, todos los que practican el mal, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me ha oído llorar!
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Váyanse|Marchaos}}, todos los que hacen el mal! {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me ha oído llorar.

vi.L: Hãy lìa xa tôi, hỡi tất cả những kẻ làm điều gian ác, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã nghe tiếng khóc của tôi.
vi.B: Hãy tránh xa tôi, hỡi tất cả những kẻ làm điều ác, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã nghe tôi khóc.
vi.R: Hỡi tất cả những kẻ làm điều ác, hãy đi đi! {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã nghe tôi khóc.

ko.L: 악을 행하는 모든 자들아, 내게서 떠나가라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 울음소리를 들으셨다.
ko.B: 악을 일삼는 자들아, 모두 내게서 물러가라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내가 우는 소리를 들으셨다.
ko.R: 악한 일을 하는 자들아, 모두 물러가라! {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내가 우는 소리를 들으셨다.

pt.L: Afastem-se de mim, todos os que praticam a iniquidade, porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} ouviu a voz do meu choro.
pt.B: Afastem-se de mim, todos os que praticam o mal, porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me ouviu chorar.
pt.R: Saiam de perto de mim, todos vocês que fazem o mal! {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} me ouviu chorando.

decisions.choice: Depart from me ... for the LORD has heard: a sudden turn
decisions.reason: The psalm turns from weeping to confidence. Many prayers for help turn in this way, once the one praying is sure God has heard (Psalm 22:22; 28:6).

decisions.choice: Depart from me, workers of iniquity: Jesus' words
decisions.reason: Jesus uses these words for those he will send away at the judgment (Matthew 7:23; Luke 13:27).

decisions.choice: workers of iniquity: those who practice evil
decisions.reason: The phrase is the one used in 5:6.

decisions.choice: Verses 9-11 speak to the evildoers and about the LORD in 해라체, and the psalmist is "나"
alternatives: 저 and 합쇼체 as in verses 2-8
decisions.reason: The psalm turns suddenly from praying to God to sending away the enemies (meaning decision m1); Korean speaks to them as one sends people away, as in the published Psalm 139:19, and speaks of the LORD in the plain written style with the honorific.

decisions.choice: Afastem-se de mim (L, B); Saiam de perto de mim (R)
decisions.reason: Jesus uses these words at the judgment (m2), and Matthew 7:23 says them in Portuguese as "afastem-se de mim" (L, B) and "Saiam de perto de mim" (R); the psalm uses the same words.

source.text: שָׁמַ֣ע יְ֭הוָה תְּחִנָּתִ֑י יְ֝הוָ֗ה תְּֽפִלָּתִ֥י יִקָּֽח׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH has heard my plea for grace; YHWH will accept my prayer.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has heard my plea for grace; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will take my prayer.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has heard me beg for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} grace; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} welcomes my prayer.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has heard me ask for mercy. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} takes my prayer to heart.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a entendu ma supplication ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} prendra ma prière.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a entendu implorer {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} accueille ma prière.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a entendu {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} demander pitié. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} prend ma prière à cœur.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesikia ombi langu la neema; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atayapokea maombi yangu.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amenisikia nikiomba neema {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anayakaribisha maombi yangu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amenisikia nikiomba rehema. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anayajali sana maombi yangu.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha oído mi súplica; {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} recibirá mi oración.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me ha oído rogar por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gracia; {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} acoge mi oración.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me ha oído pedir misericordia. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} recibe mi oración con cariño.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã nghe lời tôi nài xin ân huệ; {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ nhận lời cầu nguyện của tôi.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã nghe tôi nài xin ân huệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đón nhận lời cầu nguyện của tôi.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã nghe tôi xin thương xót. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ghi nhận lời cầu nguyện của tôi.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 간구를 들으셨다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 기도를 받으실 것이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 은혜를 구하는 내 간청을 들으셨다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 기도를 받아 주신다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 불쌍히 여겨 달라는 내 부르짖음을 들으셨다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 기도를 마음에 두신다.

pt.L: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} ouviu o meu pedido de graça; {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tomará a minha oração.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} me ouviu implorar pela {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} graça; {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} recebe bem a minha oração.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} me ouviu pedir misericórdia. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} leva a sério a minha oração.

decisions.choice: plea for grace: a request for favor
decisions.reason: The word (techinnah) comes from the verb of verse 3, "be gracious": a plea for grace.

decisions.choice: will take: accept, receive with favor
decisions.reason: To take (laqach) a prayer is to receive it. The past "has heard" and the future "will take" both express certainty.

decisions.choice: beg for his grace
decisions.reason: Balanced says whose grace is asked for, as verse 3 does.

source.text: יֵבֹ֤שׁוּ׀וְיִבָּהֲל֣וּ מְ֭אֹד כָּל־אֹיְבָ֑י יָ֝שֻׁ֗בוּ יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ רָֽגַע׃

records.literal_gloss: They will be ashamed and terrified exceedingly, all my enemies; they will turn back, they will be ashamed in a moment.

en.L: All my enemies will be ashamed and greatly terrified; they will turn back [and] be ashamed in a moment.
en.B: All my enemies will be put to shame and filled with terror; they will turn back, suddenly disgraced.
en.R: All my enemies will be ashamed and very afraid. They will suddenly turn and run away in shame.

fr.L: Tous mes ennemis seront couverts de honte et grandement épouvantés ; ils reculeront, [ils seront] honteux en un instant.
fr.B: Tous mes ennemis seront couverts de honte et remplis de terreur ; ils reculeront, déshonorés tout à coup.
fr.R: Tous mes ennemis auront honte et très peur. Tout à coup, ils feront demi-tour et s’enfuiront, couverts de honte.

sw.L: Adui zangu wote wataaibika na kutetemeka kwa hofu mno; watarudi nyuma [na] kuaibika mara moja.
sw.B: Adui zangu wote wataaibishwa na kujawa na hofu; watarudi nyuma, wakiaibishwa ghafla.
sw.R: Adui zangu wote wataona aibu na kuogopa sana. Watageuka ghafla na kukimbia kwa aibu.

es.L: Todos mis enemigos serán avergonzados y muy aterrados; se volverán atrás [y] serán avergonzados en un momento.
es.B: Todos mis enemigos quedarán en vergüenza y llenos de terror; se volverán atrás, deshonrados de repente.
es.R: Todos mis enemigos quedarán avergonzados y con mucho miedo. De pronto se darán la vuelta y huirán llenos de vergüenza.

vi.L: Mọi kẻ thù của tôi sẽ bị hổ thẹn và kinh hãi vô cùng; chúng sẽ quay lui [và] bị hổ thẹn trong chốc lát.
vi.B: Mọi kẻ thù của tôi sẽ bị sỉ nhục và đầy kinh hoàng; chúng sẽ quay lui, bỗng chốc bị hổ thẹn.
vi.R: Mọi kẻ thù của tôi sẽ bị xấu hổ và rất sợ hãi. Chúng sẽ bất ngờ quay lưng bỏ chạy trong nhục nhã.

ko.L: 내 모든 원수가 부끄러워하며 몹시 떨 것이다. 그들이 물러가 순식간에 부끄러움을 당할 것이다.
ko.B: 내 모든 원수가 수치를 당하고 공포에 질릴 것이다. 그들은 갑자기 망신을 당하고 물러갈 것이다.
ko.R: 내 원수들은 모두 부끄러워하고 몹시 두려워할 것이다. 그들은 갑자기 부끄러워하며 달아날 것이다.

pt.L: Todos os meus inimigos serão envergonhados e ficarão muito apavorados; voltarão atrás [e] serão envergonhados num instante.
pt.B: Todos os meus inimigos serão humilhados e ficarão cheios de terror; voltarão atrás, cobertos de vergonha de repente.
pt.R: Todos os meus inimigos vão ficar envergonhados e com muito medo. De repente, eles vão dar meia-volta e fugir envergonhados.

decisions.choice: will be ashamed: a statement of confidence
decisions.reason: The verbs can be read as what will happen or as a wish. Following verses 9-10, they are read as confidence.

decisions.choice: terrified, turn back: the tables turned
decisions.reason: The enemies are "terrified" with the verb used of the psalmist's bones and soul (verses 3-4), and they "turn back" with the verb he used when he asked the LORD to turn (verse 5).

decisions.choice: in a moment: suddenly
decisions.reason: The word (rega') is an instant. The long nights of weeping end with a sudden reversal.
